purpose: Teach: 標本/返却/動き出し/没頭/書斎/切り捨て/開講/社名

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 標本管理、若い頃から徹底してきた。
lines.en: I've kept strict attention to sample management since I was young.
lines.style: Measured, reflective opening. Deliberate pace on the key phrase. The tone of someone sharing hard-won principle, not boasting. Eyes slightly distant — looking back.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。返却忘れ、命取りですね。
lines.en: Yes. A forgotten return can sink everything.
lines.style: Quiet agreement, but with a hint of gravity underneath. Lean in slightly on 'sink.' Hiroshi listening intently — absorbing not just the words but their weight.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 業界が動き出した時、機敏な対応、勝負だ。
lines.en: When the industry starts to move, it's the quick response that decides the game.
lines.style: Firmer now. Slight forward lean on 'decides.' The voice of experience — not harsh, but unambiguous. A moment of direct instruction.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 若手は、業務に没頭しています。
lines.en: The younger staff are fully absorbed in their duties.
lines.style: Respectful acknowledgment, steady tone. Not defensive — simply stating fact. A measured pause before speaking, as if choosing words carefully.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 書斎での読書、習慣を続けろ。
lines.en: Keep the habit of reading in your study. Don't let it slip.
lines.style: Quiet but firm. The tone of advice that has been tested by time. Slight emphasis on 'keep' — a small anchor for the younger man to hold.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。人の切り捨ては、避けたいです。
lines.en: Yes. I'd prefer not to cut people away.
lines.style: Soft vulnerability beneath the professionalism. A slight catch in the voice — something that costs him. Hiroshi shows a human boundary here.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 新講座、開講、社名を背負って臨め。
lines.en: This new course — open it carrying the company's name with you.
lines.style: Closing wisdom. Slower, deliberate pace. Weight on 'carrying' — the metaphorical burden and honour. The last instruction of a mentor, settling into quiet finality.
